fullName: truck-junction-web-automation:cypress/e2e/ui/UsedTruck/UsedTruckPdp.cy.js#UsedTruck - UsedTruckPdp [en] — Used Truck Detail TC-UTPDP-05: Check Offers lead form shows required validation when submitted empty on Used Truck Detail
description:
**Test Case ID:** TC-UTPDP-05
**Title:** Check Offers lead form shows required validation when submitted empty on Used Truck Detail
**Language:** en

**Description:**
Open Check Offers on a used-truck detail page and submit with name, mobile and city empty.

**Expected Result:**
The real required-field validation messages are shown, and no lead is submitted.

**Steps:**
1. Open a used-truck detail page
2. Click Check Offers
3. Leave fields empty and submit
4. Verify required-field messages
